description: tvOS Portal client: the iOS profile's static composition (every first-party module linked into the app), SDL3 and the native Vulkan renderer over MoltenVK, on Apple TV. Built on a Linux host with the iOS profile's pinned host toolchain; signed and installed on a Mac.

intent.composition: static: no first-party shared library or module search path, as on iOS (AGENTS.md 'Platform-compliant composition')
intent.vulkan_implementation: MoltenVK (Vulkan portability subset over Metal), statically linked
intent.physics_provider: vphysics (IVP) by default, as on iOS and Android; vphysics_box3d is linked too
intent.input: Siri Remote and game controllers through SDL3 (GameController framework). There is no touch screen, on-screen touch controls or Core Motion; a remote's motion, if used for aiming, comes from GameController, not the iOS gyro provider.
intent.support_scope: Product scope added by the user (2026-09-25). tvOS is not one of the four AGENTS.md north-star targets; R29 neither requires nor is closed by it. No device, simulator or packaging evidence yet.
intent.packaging: .app assembled on Linux; codesign, provisioning and install on the Mac, as for iOS. The content location is an open decision (see evidence.known_blockers).
intent.deployment_target_reason: 17.0 matches the iOS profile; the SDK accepts 12.0 and later, and MoltenVK's tvOS slice is built for minos 15.0. Revisit before a store build.

tvos.bundle_id_reason: The iOS profile's bundle id (the user's choice there): one app record can then carry both platforms (universal purchase). Agent decision, 2026-09-25.
tvos.note: The iOS profile's frameworks without CoreMotion, which the tvOS SDK does not have (checked in AppleTVOS 26.5). No orientation keys: the display is landscape. A store build also needs the tvOS layered app icon and top-shelf image in an asset catalog; a development install does not.

sdk.name: AppleTVOS.sdk
sdk.source: copied from Xcode on the user's Mac (xcrun --sdk appletvos --show-sdk-path); never downloaded by the build
sdk.licence_note: Apple's Xcode licence covers use of the SDK on Apple-branded computers; placing it on the Linux build host is the user's decision (2026-09-25, 'feel free to pull the tvos SDK from macvm').

host_toolchain.note: One pin for both Apple mobile targets: the iOS profile's LLVM (AArch64), ld64.lld and cctools-port ld64 target tvOS with the arm64-apple-tvos triple and -platform_version tvos. tools/ios/build_toolchain.py builds it.

moltenvk.note: Same MoltenVK version as the iOS profile. The v1.4.2 release has no tvOS-only archive, so this pins the all-platforms release (sha256 equals the GitHub release asset digest). The tvOS static slice is arm64 and arm64e, built for tvOS minos 15.0 with SDK 26.5.

sdl3.note: The iOS profile's archive and sha256; built as a static library for tvOS.

ktx_software.note: The Android profile's archive, sha256 and CMake options, as on iOS.

vendored.source: thirdparty submodule (revision pinned by the superproject)
vendored.note: Cross-built as static libraries like the iOS profile; zlib, bzip2 and iconv come from the SDK.

content.location: undecided: tvOS gives apps no persistent local storage outside the app bundle; the caches directory can be purged by the system

required_checks: tools/ios/build_toolchain.py: the shared pinned host toolchain and its smoke test
tools/quality/static_composition.py check on the tvOS tree: Mach-O module isolation, no first-party dylib, every module linked
startup on an Apple TV with no first-party dylib or module search path
foreground/background and surface recreation, Siri Remote and game-controller input, memory pressure
content survives relaunch under the chosen storage policy
separate simulator runs (additional, not a substitute for the device)

known_blockers: No Waf tvOS target yet (DEST_OS tvos, --tvos-sdk): the xcompile, static-composition and PLATFORM_IOS paths know only iOS.
No tvOS builds of SDL3, freetype, libpng, libjpeg, curl or the KTX reader, and no .app assembly (build-ios-app.sh is iOS-only).

Content storage: Portal's content does not fit a policy yet. Options are bundling it in the app (4 GB app-size limit for tvOS, per Apple's App Store documentation; to be rechecked), on-demand resources, or the purgeable caches directory for development only. A user decision.
Input: the iOS touch controls, gyro aiming and on-screen keyboard paths do not apply; menus and play need a remote/controller mapping.
The iOS profile's open items carry over: legacy $phong descriptor-set count against MoltenVK's limit, and software DXT decompression on GPUs without BC textures (memory unmeasured).
observations: 2026-09-25: AppleTVOS 26.5 SDK (Xcode 26.6, 17F113) copied from the macOS VM to dependencies/tvos/sdk; SDKSettings allows deployment targets 12.0 to 26.5.99.

2026-09-25: link probe with the iOS profile's host toolchain (clang 22.1.8, ld64-956.6, ld64.lld): C++20/libc++ compiles for arm64-apple-tvos17.0; ld64 -r turns hidden symbols local; ld64.lld links an Objective-C++ main against UIKit, Metal, QuartzCore, IOSurface and the MoltenVK tvOS static library into a Mach-O with LC_BUILD_VERSION platform 3 (tvOS), minos 17.0, sdk 26.5, depending only on system frameworks and libraries. Never run.
